question: How many customers are there?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS number_of_customers
FROM customers;

question: What is the total revenue?
sql:
SELECT SUM(order_items.price + order_items.freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items;

question: What was the revenue in 2017?
sql:
SELECT SUM(order_items.price + order_items.freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE YEAR(orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017;

question: Which 3 product categories appear in the most order items?
sql:
SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS total_order_items
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY total_order_items DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: What share of delivered orders arrived late?

Which customer state generates the most revenue?
sql:

question: Which 3 product categories appear in the most order items?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category,
       COUNT(i.order_item_id) AS item_count
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
       ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY item_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: How many orders were canceled?

       ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS revenue

question: How many customers placed more than one order?
sql:
WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers
FROM per_customer
WHERE n_orders >= 2;

       COUNT(i.order_item_id) AS items_sold
